paragraphs: The S-Type 2.5 V6 uses the AJ-V6 — a 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 1999 to 2008 across the X200 generation. The S-Type has been part of the Jaguar range since 1999, though it's no longer in production and has been succeeded by the XF. The S-Type 2.5 V6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the S-Type 2.5 V6 from 2023 to present. The AJ-V6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ-V6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V6 rebuild.
